description: Hotel details: address, star class, amenities, Staylist's AI overview (a written summary with pros, cons and who the hotel suits, where one exists), how the hotel compares with others in its city, check-in/out times, child policy, nearest airport/station, and booking links. No photos: people see those on the booking page; for live-provider hotels also booking-site offers for the requested dates and guests (total, room, cancellation, conditions). refundable=null means unknown. Prices are not guaranteed. Preserve dates and occupancy from the search.
